items.text: Hi Omar, a quick reminder that the biosafety refresher for all lab assistants is set for Thursday, April 10, from 3:00 to 4:30 PM in Room 118, Hawley Annex. Please bring $5 for the materials fee. Sign in at the front desk. — Dr. Whitfield

questions.stem: According to the email, what are attendees asked to bring?

options.A: A copy of the biosafety refresher schedule
options.B: A signed permission form from a supervisor

questions.explanation: The email states that attendees should bring $5 for the materials fee, which matches a five-dollar payment for materials.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the biosafety refresher?

options.A: It is required for laboratory assistants.
options.B: It takes place in a large lecture hall.
options.C: It replaces an earlier training session.
options.D: It lasts for more than two hours.

questions.explanation: The email is sent to all lab assistants and describes the session as a refresher they must attend and sign in for, implying it is mandatory for them.

items.text: Notice: South Lot B will be closed for repaving from 6:00 AM Monday, June 2, through 6:00 PM Friday, June 6. Permit holders should park in West Lot C during this period. Overnight parking in Lot C is not permitted. Contact the Facilities Office at 555-0142.

questions.stem: According to the notice, where should permit holders park during the closure?

options.B: In the South Lot B overflow area

questions.explanation: The notice directs permit holders to park in West Lot C while South Lot B is being repaved.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about overnight parking during the closure?

options.A: It remains available in South Lot B.
options.B: It is prohibited in the replacement lot.
options.C: It requires a special permit from Facilities.
options.D: It moves to the North Campus Garage.

questions.explanation: Since overnight parking in Lot C is not permitted, drivers who normally park overnight cannot use the temporary replacement lot for that purpose.

items.text: Hi Dana, your tour guide shift is confirmed for Saturday, March 8, 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM, starting at the Kerr Admissions Desk. Arrive fifteen minutes early to collect your badge; late arrivals forfeit the slot. Reply by Wednesday to keep it. — Ms. Alvarez

questions.stem: According to the email, when should the volunteer arrive at the Kerr Admissions Desk?
questions.explanation: The shift begins at 9:30 AM and volunteers are told to come fifteen minutes early, which means arriving at 9:15 AM.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about volunteers who arrive after the shift begins?

options.A: They can collect badges at the front desk.
options.B: They will be given a different shift time.
options.C: They must reply to Ms. Alvarez by Wednesday.
options.D: They will lose their assigned shift.

questions.explanation: The email warns that late arrivals forfeit the slot, meaning someone who shows up after the start time gives up that shift.

items.text: The campus garden is open again! Hours are Tuesdays and Thursdays, 4:00-6:00 PM, behind Beale Hall. I grabbed basil and tomato starts for $3.50 each — honestly the best deal on campus. Bring cash, since they can't take cards yet. See you there!

questions.stem: According to the post, when is the campus garden open?
questions.explanation: The post lists opening hours as Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4:00 to 6:00 PM, which are late-afternoon times.

questions.stem: In the post, the word "starts" is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: The writer bought basil and tomato starts for $3.50 each, so "starts" refers to small young plants meant for planting.
